groups.name: Annotation model and rendering
groups.rationale: Defines the data structures and pure functions that turn text selections into queued annotations and render the popup UI.
groups.watch: The annotation grouping logic merges fragments from the same file but keeps files separate, which is the contract the popup DOM code must respect; if a selection spans files, the comment must still attach to each file independently.

groups.name: Conversation panel rendering and state
groups.rationale: Defines the right-side panel UI as pure functions: delivered conversation entries, queued annotation pills, comment box, and send buttons.
groups.watch: The pending queue in the panel is the browser's own unsent buffer, separate from the server's pending prompts; the distinction matters for what the UI shows as removable, and the rendering must not expose server-side state as dismissable.

groups.name: Session API client
groups.rationale: Centralizes all HTTP calls to the backend: fetching session data, persisting reviewed flags, and sending feedback with prompts.
groups.watch: The `SessionData` interface exported here is the contract between the server and all three mounted components; changes to it ripple through diff mount, panel mount, and the main orchestrator.

groups.name: Diff view mounting and update
groups.rationale: Mounts the rendered diff groups into the DOM and handles checkbox interactions for reviewing; extracted to a mountable component so the main orchestrator can wire it to SSE updates.
groups.watch: The `update` method discards the old diff and redraws from scratch; if a re-group arrives while the user is scrolled deep in the old diff, focus will be lost and the scroll position reset to top.

groups.name: Annotation popup mounting and interaction
groups.rationale: Wires text selection events to the popup UI, splits selections along file blocks, and queues annotations via the callback.
groups.watch: Selection fragments are extracted by intersecting the range with `.lsr-file` blocks and grabbing `.d2h-code-line` text content; if a block has no `data-file` attribute the block is skipped entirely, so the data model must guarantee every renderable file block carries that attribute.

groups.name: Conversation panel mounting and interaction
groups.rationale: Mounts the panel into the DOM, manages the browser's pending queue, wires pill removal and send buttons to the API, and redraws after each state change.
groups.watch: The `send` method clears the pending queue only after the server responds successfully; if the fetch fails, the queue is left intact so the user can retry, but the error message is generic to avoid repeating implementation detail.

groups.name: Main entry point and orchestration
groups.rationale: Wires all three mounted components together, fetches the initial session, and hooks SSE updates to refresh the diff and panel when a re-group arrives.
groups.watch: The SSE event listener calls `diff.update()` and `panel.update()` both on a re-group; if one throws, the other does not run, leaving the UI in an inconsistent state where one view is fresh and the other is stale.

groups.name: Styles for annotation and panel UI
groups.rationale: Adds CSS for the popup, pills, general comment box, send buttons, and delivered conversation entries to match the existing editor aesthetic.
groups.watch: The `.lsr-popup` is positioned absolutely and appended to `body` so it floats above the scrolling diff; if the popup's z-index is too low or the parent chain breaks `position: absolute`, the popup will be occluded or misplaced.

groups.name: Build entry point update
groups.rationale: Redirects the build to the new nested entry point in `src/browser/dom/main.ts` after the old file was moved.
groups.watch: The path must match the new location exactly; a typo here silently builds the old entry point or fails the build before reaching the others.

groups.name: TypeScript configuration
groups.rationale: Moves the DOM exclusion from the root tsconfig to cover the whole `src/browser/dom/` folder, since that directory now contains all DOM-touching modules and is checked by a separate browser config.
groups.watch: The exclusion must cover every file under `dom/` or the root config will try to check DOM code and fail; the comment explains why the separation exists, so a future maintainer knows not to merge it back.

groups.name: Task tracking
groups.rationale: Marks Task 8 (browser annotation and conversation panel) as complete in both plan and todo files.
groups.watch: The acceptance criteria in todo.md lists specific UI behaviors and POST body shape; if the code does not match those details, the task is not truly done, so the tracking should stay false.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
